pages.title: Power Across Mods
pages.text:
Create runs on **rotation**. Many other machines run on **[#](2E5AAC)[Forge Energy (FE)](entry://industry/electricity)[#]()**. They never mix on their own: you need a converter block in between.\
\
Full detail: [#](2E5AAC)[Rotation vs Electricity](entry://industry/power_compared)[#]().

pages.title: Rotation to FE
pages.text: Crafts & Additions' Alternator turns spin into FE. It needs at least 32 [#](7A3C9A)[RPM](entry://glossary/rpm)[#]().

pages.title: FE to Rotation
pages.text: Crafts & Additions' Electric Motor turns FE back into spin at the RPM you set.

Rotation sources beyond [#](2E5AAC)[water, wind and steam](entry://create_basics/power_sources)[#]():
- [#](2E5AAC)[TFMG engines](entry://industry/tfmg_engines)[#]() burning oil products
- The [#](2E5AAC)[Create Nuclear reactor](entry://industry/nuclear)[#]()
- Create Propulsion's Stirling Engine, which turns heat into spin
- Electric Motors running on FE

Things that want FE: Create Propulsion's Ion Thruster, Flight Control's vector ion thrusters and the Deep Seas Electrolyzer on [#](2E5AAC)[submarines](entry://ocean/submarines)[#]().\
\
TFMG wires its own voltage circuits, but its connectors can import or export FE.
